title: Briefing Senate Intelligence Committee investigators unaware of facilities

tellings.quote: Now when I was briefing the senior investigators for Senate Intelligence Committee when I first started meeting with them, they didn't know we had these facilities.

plain: Steven Greer, a man who says he has briefed many officials about UFOs, says he once met with senior investigators for the Senate Intelligence Committee, the group of US senators who oversee the country's spy agencies. He says that when he first started meeting them, they did not know certain secret facilities existed. If true, it would mean secret work was being hidden even from the people meant to oversee it.
